reason: The cited evidence (E1, E3) supports uniform elemental distribution and formation of a spinel layer after 800°C treatment, but it does not directly link the spinel layer to improved wear resistance or hardness increase via second-phase strengthening, nor does it mention lattice distortion as a promoter of spinel formation. The wear barrier mechanism is thus largely unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Equiatomic Fe20Co20Ni20Mn20Cu20 HEA coating has a uniform elemental distribution that reduces segregation.
Thermal exposure at 800°C forms a continuous protective spinel oxide layer, e.g., (Fe,Co,Ni,Mn,Cu)3O4.
This spinel layer increases hardness and acts as a wear barrier by reducing direct metal contact.
The spinel formation is promoted by lattice distortion inherent in the HEA.
